blocks.simulatedrubies:actuator.tooltip.summary: This _linear actuator_ can be used to extend or retract a _sub-level_, similar to a _Mechanical Piston_.
blocks.simulatedrubies:chunk_loader.tooltip.beh: Loads chunks around the sub-level _as it moves_.
Loads more chunks around it, depending on the _strength_ of the signal.
blocks.simulatedrubies:fake_shaft: I got bullied into saying I'm a Shaft
blocks.simulatedrubies:horizon_gyro.tooltip.sum: Attempts to align the sub-level to the world's _horizon_.
blocks.simulatedrubies:inverted_gyro.tooltip.su: Attempts to align the sub-level to the normal gravity vector, _g_.
blocks.simulatedrubies:load_detector.tooltip.su: Emits a _Redstone signal_ when the _chunk_ it is in gets _loaded_.
blocks.simulatedrubies:pole.shaftwarn: Click with 2+ Shafts on a standalone Pole to place them inside.
blocks.simulatedrubies:pole.tooltip.behaviour1: When placed in front, it will _extend_ the Actuator's _extension length_.
blocks.simulatedrubies:pole.tooltip.behaviour2: _Slides within_ the Pole. Use of _Brackets_ lets you connect outside blocks more realistically.
blocks.simulatedrubies:pole.tooltip.behaviour3: _Places_ two Shafts in a _sub-level_ inside, slightly coming out of both ends of the Pole. Great for starting a Pole pipe.
blocks.simulatedrubies:pole.tooltip.summary: A low-friction pole with a hollow center that could, if placed on another sub-level, _fit a Shaft_.
blocks.simulatedrubies:redstone_gyro.tooltip.su: Attempts to align the sub-level based on _Redstone_ signals input from the _side_.
blocks.simulatedrubies:redstone_link.tooltip.be: Click on a placed Link with another Link.
Place a _paired_ Link item in _Frequency #1_. The Networked Redstone Link will then act as a normal link.
blocks.simulatedrubies:redstone_link.tooltip.co: To pair up two or more Links
To connect alongside a normal Link
blocks.simulatedrubies:redstone_link.tooltip.su: A Redstone Link, but without item frequencies. Pairs similar to _Stock Links_, but for _Redstone_.
